nodes.summary: Some $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ with $n > 3$ has no finite-index subgroup of positive first Betti number. It is not the case that for every natural number $n > 3$ the automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ of the free group $F_n$ on $n$ generators has a finite-index subgroup $H$ whose first Betti number, the $\mathbb{Z}$-rank of the abelianization of $H$, is positive.
